tex_content.html: \begin{claim} \end{claim}[The backward-flowed base point lies in the rescaled standard-flow ball] For sufficiently small surgery control, the point obtained by flowing a rescaled counterexample backward to the surgery time lies in the image of the standard-flow ball $B(p_0,A)$. \end{claim}
